subject: Physics
scope: Six already-existing multi-step AQA AS school-mock Physics Electricity and Mechanics/Materials questions: potential dividers (2), cells/internal resistance (1), filament-lamp I-V data (1), equilibrium couples (1) and Young modulus with uncertainty (1). Not flashcards.
method: Exact original source IDs, AQA section, mock/AS eligibility, number of marks, original prompt and model-answer hashes and mark-point arrays must all match before selecting the existing point-by-point manual working route. Saved answers/XP, diagrams and all original content are left untouched.
limits: Manual checking requires the student to compare real mathematical/scientific working with each rubric point; no automatic credit for keyword hits.
This does not independently certify all equivalent solutions, all actual photographed working or every AQA mock specification item.
Previously labelled manual drawing questions remain handled separately and unchanged.
